summary: Protected .github PR4592 adds an optional upper_bound_profile beside the source-observation ledger. Its shipped profile has unknown inventories and no component bound or selected runtime/source proof. The protected REVIEWED_UPPER_BOUND_CONTRACTS registry is empty. A complete profile requires exact runtime implementation/version/build/architecture/allocator/storage and topology; closed authority, managed, Python, backend, peer, transport/kernel/cache, diagnostic/export and observation domains; each role assigned once to a disjoint allocation class; positive finite maximum multiplicity; separate capacity, header, allocator-rounding, storage-metadata and transport/cache upper-bound metrics; immutable component source and cumulative operation/uncertainty lifetime reservations. Null quantities, inventories or unknown/expired ownership remain unresolved, never zero. An empty domain list claims absence and needs whole-profile protected review plus proved completeness obligations; a caller-only empty claim is unresolved. Completeness covers the call graph, representations, overhead/storage, uncertainty/replacements, concurrency/restart, diagnostic recipients, transient exclusions and runtime/source layout. Transient exclusion needs bounded non-authority lifetime and a separate finite budget; task completion, GC, timeout, cancellation or restart grants no release discount. Shared allocation roles need reviewed identity proof; equal values do not prove aliases. Complete accounting additionally requires the exact whole-profile identity/digest in the protected registry: syntactic source citations, hashes, proved flags and claimed review fields cannot supply trust. Checked signed-64-bit arithmetic sums multiplicity times all physical metrics only for a finite complete trusted profile; partial sums are not reported. Explicitly synthetic test-only trust fixtures exercise arithmetic and absent/shared domains, not production proof. The finite-complete result supplies an upper bound only, with admission false and no cap/fit field. Omitting the optional profile preserves the historical result shape; all 215 observations, sixteen aliases, eleven obligations and fourteen separate groups/results remain unchanged. Production physical bound and fit remain unproved. This is an accepted source schema, not a reviewed producer bound, selected replacement cap, native runtime/profile qualification, installed adoption, custody/enrollment or effect authority. ADR-0093 and the UTEL owning roadmap remain canonical; original .103 stays attempted-unknown/unreplayed and .104 held, without renewed cutoff or retention.
title: Complete physical upper bounds require a reviewed closed profile; the production ledger remains unresolved
